# STAT 1100 Group Project Starter Script
# Methodology Framework: Machine Learning Essentials (Chapter 32)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load required packages
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
library(caret)

library(rpart)

library(rpart.plot)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 1: Load and Clean Clinical Health Data
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
heart_data <- read.csv("heart.csv")

head(heart_data)

str(heart_data)

#create original dataset file
write.csv(heart_data, "Heart_Original.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Remove duplicate rows
heart_data <- unique(heart_data)

#Create cleaned dataset file
write.csv(heart_data, "Heart_Cleaned.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Convert the numerical target to a descriptive category factor
heart_data$target <- factor(
  heart_data$target,
  levels = c(0, 1),
  labels = c("No_Disease", "Disease")
)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 2: Balanced 80/20 Data Partitioning
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(123) # Lock seed for consistent groups across computers

# Generate training indices preserving class balance
train_index <- createDataPartition(heart_data$target, p = 0.80, list = FALSE)
train_data  <- heart_data[train_index, ]
test_data   <- heart_data[-train_index, ]

#Create files for both train and test datas
write.csv(train_data, "Train_Data.csv", row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(test_data, "Test_Data.csv", row.names = FALSE)
